inventory.sourceFigureDescription: Flow map of pyrimidine synthesis (CPS2 → carbamoyl aspartate → orotic acid → UMP) and purine synthesis (PRPP → IMP branch), with salvage routes and inhibitor sites (hydroxyurea, 5-FU, methotrexate, mycophenolate, leflunomide)

notes: Original KYP redraws preserve the source figures' educational content (atom-to-precursor mapping with color coding; pathway topology with every inhibitor at its exact step) without copying First Aid artwork. Atom assignments verified against the rendered source page (VLM): purine — Gly C4/C5/N7, Asp N1, Gln N3/N9, CO2 C6, THF C2/C8; pyrimidine — carbamoyl phosphate C2/N3, Asp N1/C4/C5/C6.
